canonical_example.text: El total del deber y del haber tienen que ser iguales.
canonical_example.translation: The debit and credit side totals must be equal.

canonical_example.text: Tiene tres artículos publicados a su haber.
canonical_example.translation: She has three published articles to her credit.

canonical_example.text: Todavía no me han pagado los haberes del mes pasado.
canonical_example.translation: I still haven't been paid last month's earnings.

canonical_example.text: Se las va a haber con su hermano si no paran de discutir.
canonical_example.translation: He's going to have it out with his brother if they don't stop arguing.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to have it out with somebody
